author: 1nc0mp3t3nc3
body:
I think I'll keep upgrading it, though I don't have that much cursed ortanite, certainly not enough for MF yet.


After doing head number-crunching, it wouldn't work well with my current Deity build, which is Deity+Tamer w/Ashen Phoenix.

My biggest focus has been maximising pet synergy and ward, so that way I never have to worry about casting DC or ward maintenance skills like the seal/strikes and I can focus on maintaining damage output similar to that of my phoenix
